paragraphs: A High Priest in the Second Temple period. Parah, mishnah 5, mentions that he prepared a red heifer; Hyman reports the Matnita of the Westerners reading ben HaKayyaf.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The frozen locator is “Parah, mishnah 5” without a chapter. The corresponding Elyehoeinai ben HaKof red-heifer entry appears in the consulted Mishnah Parah 3:5. Matnita of the Westerners is retained as the source’s version designation; the HaKayyaf reading is attributed to Hyman.

The whole Torat Emet Mishnah Parah 3:5 paragraph names Elyehoeinai ben HaKof among those who prepared a red heifer. Hyman’s body locator remains mishnah 5 without adding a chapter, beside the existing contextual 3:5 note. The Matnita of the Westerners HaKayyaf reading and source period designation remain Hyman’s reports; the separate witness was not freshly collated.
